description: Get the recommended steel-tip, double-out checkout for a score from 2 to 170: the route for 3, 2 and 1 darts in hand, alternatives on other doubles, and the best setup shot when there is no finish. Bogey numbers (159, 162, 163, 165, 166, 168, 169) and scores over 170 return checkout:false with the reason. Same routes as the dolfdarts.com/checkouts/<score> page, whose URL is included.

dartsInHand.description: Darts still in hand this visit (default 3). The result always includes the play for 3, 2 and 1 darts.

preferDouble.description: Optional favourite finish, e.g. 'D16', 'D20' or 'Bull'. Adds the best published route ending on it, when one exists.

score.description: Points left to finish (steel tip, double out). Checkouts exist for 2–170; anything else returns a 'no checkout' result.

name: get_checkout
title: Get the darts checkout for a score
